spans.s: धुन, अस्, आ, अम्, shaking. See col. 3.
धुन; add — (अम्), n. one million billions.

धून, अस्, आ, अम्, shaken, agitated; distressed
by heat or thirst.
धुनान, अस्, आ, अम्, shaking, agitating.

धूनन, अस्, m. wind; (अम्), n. the act of
shaking, agitation.
धुनि, इस्, इस्, इ. See col. 3.

धुनि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. sounding, roaring, blustering;
(Sāy.) shaking, agitating, causing to tremble, (fr. rt.
1. धु); (इस्), m. epithet of the Soma; N. of a
demon slain by Indra; (इस् or धुनी), f. a river [cf.
नदी]; (अयस्), m. pl. ‘the agitators,’ an epithet of
the Maruts.
—धुनि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. roaring,
sounding; (Sāy.) agitated, trembling.
—धुनि-
व्रत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. habitually roaring or bluster-
ing; (Sāy.) whose function is the agitation or shaking
(of trees &c.).
—धुनी-नाथ, अस्, m. ‘lord of the
rivers,’ the ocean.
धुन्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, shaking, agitating.
धुन्वान, अस्, आ, अम्, shaking, agitating.

धुनय (fr. धुनि below), Nom. P. A. धुन-
यति, -ते, &c., Ved. to sound, roar, to flow with a
roaring noise; to flow.

धूनय (fr. धून), Nom. P. A. धूनयति,
-ते, &c. (generally considered as the Caus. of rt. 1.
धू), to shake, agitate, move to and fro.

धुन्धु धुन्धु, उस्, m., N. of an Asura slain
by Kuvalāśva (or Kuvalayāśva), father of Sunda; (a
various reading for चुञ्चु who was a descendant of
Tri-śaṅku.)
—धुन्धु-मार, अस्, m. ‘the slayer
of Dhundhu,’ epithet of Kuvalāśva (Kuvalayāśva), a
son of Tri-śaṅku and father of Yuvanāśva; a house-
lizard (? = गृहालिक); an insect, coccinella (=
इन्द्र-गोप, शक्र-गोप); a kind of plant (=
गृह-धूम); the smoke of a house (?), cf.
दुन्दु-मार.
—धुन्धुमारोपाख्यान (˚र-
उप्˚), अम्, n. ‘the episode of Dhundhu-māra,’ N. of
the seventeenth chapter of the Svarga-khaṇḍa or
third part of the Padma-Purāṇa.

धूनक, अस्, m. the resin of the Shorea Robusta
or resin in general; [cf. धूर्ण and धूण.]
